# Protocol Buffers v31.1 provenance

`protoc-bin-vendored 3.2.0` records compiler version `v31.1` and its platform
packages contain Google-built compiler binaries and Google `.proto` includes.
The upstream annotated `v31.1` tag resolves to commit
`74211c0dfc2777318ab53c2cd2c317a2ef9012de`.

`LICENSE` is an exact copy from that commit and has SHA-256
`6e5e117324afd944dcf67f36cf329843bc1a92229a8cd9bb573d7a83130fea7d`.
The upstream tree at that commit has no root `NOTICE` file. The retained
license applies to the compiler and include payload distributed inside the
platform crates; this package does not claim those build-time files are linked
into `engorch-ri`.
